---
name: Feature request
about: Suggest an idea, a new AWS service, a new system design challange, or an improvement
title: '[Feature]: '
labels: enhancement
assignees: ''
---

## What would you like to see?

A clear description of the feature, service, or improvement you have in mind.

## The problem it solves

What are you trying to do today that is harder than it should be?

## How you imagine it working

Describe the behavior, the UI, or the simulation result you expect.

## Alternatives you have considered

Any other approaches you thought about.

## Additional context

Links, references to AWS docs, pricing pages, or screenshots that help explain the idea.
